messages:
maya-sec: FYI vuln-scan flagged a high severity in the canary image artifact: registry.redwood/staging/base:2026-03-20-rc2. Affects libssl (CVE-2026-1001) and a packaging issue in apk. Need image rebuild + resigning. Also KMS access for cosign seems blocked by current key policy. paging @jess-infra @ryan-sre

jess-infra: copy of the scan?

maya-sec: paste below (sanitized):

```
VULN: CVE-2026-1001 libssl 1.1.1k -> CVSS 8.2
PATH: /usr/lib/libssl.so.1.1
STATUS: fix available in openssl 1.1.1m
ARTIFACT: registry.redwood/staging/base:2026-03-20-rc2
TRIAGE: high - remote exploit
```

maya-sec: Also found build logs showing cosign failed with KMS error during automated sign: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/cosign-key` -> permission denied

ryan-sre: Canary traffic is at 1% currently. Do we need to pause rollout?

jess-infra: Please drop traffic to 0. Can confirm we can rollback quickly. I'll also check the key policy now.

opsec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-043: container-vuln-canary. Priority: P2.

andrew-eng: I can kick off a minimal base rebuild (remove problematic package, pin upstream patch) and push a signed image to staging. ETA ~90m if we get KMS access for the signing principal.

jess-infra: Key policy snippet currently (redacted) denies non-prod service accounts. We need to allow the build-service SA to use kms.cryptoSign and cloudkms.signBlob. Proposed temporary policy change:

```
{ "bindings": [ { "role": "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier", "members": ["serviceAccount:build-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] } ] }
```

jess-infra: Will submit IAM change request. Need @andrew-eng to confirm which identity cosign uses in CI (service account or workload identity).

andrew-eng: CI uses workload-identity mapped to build-service SA. Confirmed. I'll wait for IAM change then trigger rebuild.

maya-sec: Audit logging ask: we need immutable audit logs for the signing action for 90 days and export to GCS. Can infra enable key usage audit sink? Also will need an entry in compliance ticket.

ryan-sre: We already export KMS audit logs to centralized GCS bucket with 30d retention. I can extend retention to 90d for the bucket that holds kms/crypto logs. Will do after change is approved.

jess-infra: Quick checklist I'm going to run: 1) submit IAM change with temporary 2hr TTL 2) update key rotation notice to compliance 3) test cosign sign on staging 4) re-run vuln-scan 5) if clean, promote; else rollback and rebuild with different base.

maya-sec: For triage: if patched image still shows the CVE in scan (false positive), we'll escalate to upstream package team. Otherwise green = promote. I'll create a short triage doc and link the results to INC-2026-043.

andrew-eng: Starting rebuild now (local patch + reprovision build). Pushing to registry.redwood/staging/base:2026-03-20-rc2-rebuild. Will attempt cosign after IAM update.

jess-infra: IAM change submitted; approval webhook to compliance required. Tagging @opsec-bot to track.

opsec-bot: Compliance approval requested for IAM change #IAM-462.

ryan-sre: I paused canary traffic to 0. Standby for rebuild validation.

andrew-eng: Build finished, pushed unsigned image. Waiting on cosign sign step.

jess-infra: IAM change approved by compliance (temporary allow). Cosign sign tested successfully on staging. Command used: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/cosign-key registry.redwood/staging/base:2026-03-20-rc2-rebuild`

maya-sec: Re-run vuln-scan -> initial result: libssl CVE no longer detected in staged image. Running full regression suite now.

andrew-eng: If regression passes, I'll push to canary and increment to 0.5% then monitor.

ryan-sre: Will monitor latency and error budgets. If anything unusual, I'll drop traffic and revert.

maya-sec: Closing loop: after promote, rotate signing key within next 7 days and audit who used it (log export saved). Also add an automated check in CI to fail signing if KMS returns permission denied (so we don't push unsigned).

jess-infra: Noting follow-ups for backlog: (a) tighten key policy for least privilege (b) document temp IAM emergency flow (c) automate audit export retention policy.

maya-sec: Thanks all :thumbsup: Good job moving fast and tracing changes. Will attach final vuln-scan report to INC-2026-043 once regression completes.
